section_header: FRONT AXLE AND SUSPENSION — Front Suspension
title: Stabilizer Bar

content.description: Illustration showing the removal of stabilizer bar from strut bar brackets, with hands using tools to disconnect components

items: DISCONNECT STABILIZER BAR FROM LOWER ARMS
REMOVE BOTH STABILIZER BAR BRACKETS FROM STRUT BAR BRACKETS
REMOVE STRUT BAR WITH STRUT BAR BRACKET ON ONE SIDE
(a) Remove the two nuts, and disconnect the strut bar from the lower arm.
(b) Remove the four strut bar bracket bolts.

content.description: Close-up illustration of strut bar bracket showing bolt locations and removal points

content.text: Pull out the stabilizer bar through the strut bar bracket hole.

content.description: Illustration showing insertion of stabilizer bar through strut bar bracket hole with directional arrow

content.text: 1. INSERT STABILIZER BAR THROUGH STRUT BAR BRACKET HOLE
Install the strut bar bracket and torque the bolts.
3. INSTALL STRUT BAR TO LOWER ARM
Install the strut bar and torque the nuts.

content.component: Strut bar to lower arm nuts

content.description: Illustration showing installation of stabilizer bar on brackets with torque wrench application

content.text: Place the stabilizer bar in position and install both stabilizer bushing and brackets on the strut bar brackets. Torque the bolts.

content.description: Illustration showing connection of stabilizer bar to lower arms with bolts, cushions and nuts, with reference number A92027

content.text: 5. CONNECT STABILIZER BAR TO LOWER ARMS
Connect the stabilizer bar on both sides to the lower arms with bolts, cushions and nuts as shown. Torque the nuts.
